result.summary: The page is generally usable, but there are a few visual/accessibility concerns: icon-only controls lack clear labels, some secondary text is low contrast, and horizontally scrolling content is clipped at the right edge without a strong scroll affordance.

issues.description: Favorite heart buttons and the notification bell appear to be icon-only controls with no visible label or accessible name.
issues.suggestion: Add accessible labels such as 'Save Tokumaru Ramen Bar' and 'Notifications', and ensure focus states are visible.

issues.description: Secondary metadata like delivery fees and time ranges use small gray text that may be hard to read for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Increase font size and/or darken the gray to meet WCAG contrast guidance.

issues.description: Category chips and restaurant cards are cut off at the right edge; this helps imply scrolling but the clipped 'Healthy' chip and partially visible restaurant card can look unintentionally cropped.
issues.suggestion: Add a clearer scroll affordance, edge fade, or adjust card widths so truncation looks deliberate.

issues.description: The 'Pizza' category is selected while visible recommendations include ramen, burgers, and poké, which may make the filter state feel inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Either filter content to match the selected category or make clear that home sections remain personalized regardless of chip selection.
